digest.en: Mamata Banerjee's BJP rival won big in India's Tamil Nadu state. The results are making waves across Asia with Sri Lanka's media covering the story. A separate incident occurred in China where 26 people were killed in a fireworks factory blast.
digest.hi: प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की मई में चार यूरोपीय देशों की महत्वपूर्ण यात्रा चर्चाओं में है। भारत ने फुजैरा में ईरानी हमले की कड़ी निंदा की और कहा कि कूटनीति और बातचीत से मुद्दों का समाधान होना चाहिए। अगले संयुक्त राष्ट्र प्रमुख के लिए महिला उम्मीदवार का चीन ने समर्थन किया है।

articles.title: A 'fun' superstar stuns rivals and reshapes politics in an Indian state
articles.summary: Film star Vijay has won nearly all seats in Tamil Nadu polls, a surprise upset that shakes the state's politics. His victory marks a significant shift in the region's power dynamics, with implications for the future of Indian politics.

articles.title: Sri Lanka’s media spotlight Vijay’s big win in Tamil Nadu
articles.summary: Tamil politicians have congratulated Vijay on his election win in Tamil Nadu, expressing hope for cooperation. Sri Lankan media outlets have also highlighted the significance of his victory, noting its potential impact on regional politics.

articles.title: 26 killed, 61 injured in blast at fireworks factory in China
articles.summary: A blast at a fireworks factory in China killed 26 people and injured 61. Rescue teams, including nearly 500 personnel, were deployed to the scene, and evacuations were conducted in areas deemed hazardous.

articles.title: US To Pakistan, How International Media Covered BJP's Victory In Bengal
articles.summary: Pakistan's Dawn newspaper carried an AFP report on the BJP's victory in Bengal, highlighting the international media's coverage of the election. The report noted the significance of the win for India's ruling party.

articles.title: US Links Hormuz 'Freedom' To India's LPG Needs
articles.summary: The US has linked the freedom of the Hormuz Strait to India's liquefied petroleum gas needs, citing a potential shortfall of up to 10 million barrels per day due to the crisis.

articles.title: Ukraine and Russia declare separate truces
articles.summary: Russia declared a ceasefire on May 8 and 9 for Victory Day celebrations. Ukraine's President Zelenskyy announced a separate ceasefire regime on May 5 and 6. Russia declares a ceasefire on May 8, 9 for Victory Day celebrations; Ukraine’s Zelenskyy announces his own ceasefire regime on May 5, 6.

articles.title: Nine workers killed in Colombia coal mine explosion
articles.summary: A coal mine explosion in Colombia killed nine workers. The national mining agency had warned of a gas buildup at the mine weeks earlier. The national mining ​agency had warned weeks earlier that a buildup of gases at the mine could become dangerous.

articles.title: Taiwan's Lai returns from Eswatini trip amid China objection
articles.summary: Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te returned home from Eswatini after visiting the tiny African kingdom. Three Indian Ocean countries denied him permission to fly through their airspace. Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te has arrived home from the tiny African kingdom of Eswatini after three China-friendly Indian Ocean countries denied him permission to fly through their airspace.

articles.title: Cruise ship with 150 aboard waits for help, not allowed to dock
articles.summary: A cruise ship with 150 people waited for help off the coast of Cape Verde in the Atlantic Ocean. No one was allowed to disembark. No one has been allowed to disembark the ship that is waiting off the coast of Cape Verde in the Atlantic Ocean.

articles.title: Russian drones, missiles kill five at Ukraine's Naftogaz gas production plants, CEO says
articles.summary: Russian drones and missiles attacked Ukraine's Naftogaz gas production plants, killing five people. The attacks left 37 people wounded. The ​attacks left 37 ⁠people wounded. Russian drones, missiles kill five at Ukraine's Naftogaz gas production plants, CEO says.

articles.title: An explosion at a fireworks plant in China kills at least 26 people, state media says
articles.summary: An explosion at a fireworks plant in central China killed at least 26 people. Authorities have largely completed search and rescue efforts, but verification of casualties and identification of victims are still underway.

articles.title: PM Modi After Iran's Attack On UAE Port Injures 3 Indians
articles.summary: Iranian attacks on a UAE port injured three Indian nationals. The incident occurred on March 14 at the Fujairah oil industry zone, prompting concern from Indian Prime Minister Modi. Fujairah oil industry zone also came under Iranian attack on March 14 (File Photo).

articles.title: PM Modi condemns attacks on the UAE, which resulted in injuries to three Indian nationals
articles.summary: Indian Prime Minister Modi condemned attacks on the UAE, which injured three Indian nationals. The attacks followed a US initiative to open the Strait of Hormuz to shipping. U. S. President Donald ​Trump launched “Project Freedom” seeking to open the Strait of Hormuz to shipping, prompting Iran to lash out.

articles.title: Thiago Ávila’s letter from Israeli prison to his daughter
articles.summary: Brazilian activist Thiago Ávila, in an Israeli prison, wrote to his daughter explaining his motivation for joining a Gaza-bound humanitarian flotilla. articles.title: Nine killed in Colombia mine explosion: government
articles.summary: A coal mine explosion in central Colombia killed nine people. The blast was caused by a buildup of gases inside the mine. There was an explosion inside a coal mine in central Colombia caused by a buildup of gases.

articles.title: Explosion at fireworks factory in China kills 26, injures 61
articles.summary: An explosion at a fireworks factory in China killed 26 people and injured 61. Rescue efforts are still underway in China's fireworks capital. Rescue efforts are still under way after a huge explosion ripped through China's fireworks capital.

articles.title: What’s happening on day 67 as Hormuz crisis deepens?
articles.summary: The UAE intercepted Iranian missiles after a suspected drone attack. Iran has not commented on the incident. The UAE says it intercepted Iranian missiles after a suspected drone attack, with no comment from Iran.

articles.title: FIFA bans former Guyana official Alves for 5 years over sexual harassment
articles.summary: FIFA banned former Guyana official Ian Alves for 5 years for sexually harassing female staff members. The ban was imposed by FIFA's Ethics Committee. Former General Secretary Ian Alves found guilty of sexually harassing female staff ​members by FIFA's Ethics Committee.

articles.title: Pant not feeling the price tag pressure in IPL, says coach Langer
articles.summary: Kolkata Knight Riders coach Justin Langer said that their player Nitish Pant is not feeling pressure about his high price tag in the IPL. Pant not feeling the price tag pressure in IPL, says coach Langer.

articles.title: Russia and Ukraine declare competing ceasefires
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine declared competing ceasefires. The moves were reported by Al Jazeera. Russia and Ukraine declare competing ceasefires Al Jazeera.

articles.title: Iran renames Trump's Strait of Hormuz plan - and warns there's 'no military solution'
articles.summary: Iran renamed a plan to secure the Strait of Hormuz, previously proposed by US President Trump, and cautioned that there is "no military solution" to the region's tensions. The Strait of Hormuz is a vital waterway for global oil shipments, and Iran-US relations have been strained.
